description_en: Verifies the authenticity and consistency of the name and ID card number extracted via OCR from the front and back images of an ID card against an authoritative source
description_zh: API服务，入参身份证正反面，OCR提取姓名和身份证号，通过权威源核验其真实性及一致性
kebab_example:
aliyun cloudauth id-2-meta-verify-with-ocr --cert-url https://www.aliyun.com/cert.jpeg --cert-file '无' --cert-national-url 'https://www.aliyun.com/cert.jpeg
' --cert-national-file '无' --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Id2MetaVerifyWithOCR

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image for the portrait side of the ID card.
The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link.
Specify either CertUrl or CertFile
parameters.help_zh:
身份证人像面图片。
公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接。
CertUrl和CertFile二选一
parameters.name: cert_url

parameters.help_en:
The input stream of the image for the portrait side of the ID card.
Specify either CertUrl or CertFile
parameters.help_zh:
身份证人像面图片输入流。
CertUrl和CertFile二选一
parameters.name: cert_file

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image for the national emblem side of the ID card.
The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link.
Specify either CertNationalUrl or CertNationalFile, or leave both empty
parameters.help_zh:
身份证国徽面图片地址。国徽面
公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接。
CertNationalUrl和CertNationalFile二选一入参，也可以都不传递
parameters.name: cert_national_url

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image of the national emblem side of the ID card. You can specify either CertNationalUrl or CertNationalFile. You can also specify neither
parameters.help_zh:
身份证国徽面图片地址。
CertNationalUrl和CertNationalFile二选一，也可以都不传递
parameters.name: cert_national_file

Code.description_en:
The return code. A value of 200 indicates success, and other values indicate failure.
Important
This parameter indicates whether the API operation is called successfully. For detailed return code descriptions, see Error codes.
To view the business verification results, check the fields in ResultObject
Code.description_zh:
返回码：200表示成功，其他均为失败。
重要
此参数代表是否正确调用了接口，详细的返回码说明请参见错误码。
业务核验结果请通过ResultObject中的字段查看

Message.description_en:
The message returned for the API call.
Important
This parameter only indicates whether an exception occurs during the API call
Message.description_zh:
接口调用返回信息。
重要
此参数仅表示接口是否异常

BizCode.description_en:
The identity verification result. Valid values:
1: Consistent.
2: Inconsistent.
3: No record found
BizCode.description_zh:
身份核验结果：
1：校验⼀致
2：校验不⼀致
3：查⽆记录
